payload.title: Tomato leaves turning brown - any ideas?
payload.body_html:
Tomato leaves turning brown - any ideas?

gardener_ann: The lower leaves on my tomatoes are turning brown at the edges. I water in the morning and the plants get full sun. Has anyone seen this before?

plotholder_raj: Sounds like early blight to me. Remove the affected leaves and mulch the soil so rain does not splash spores upward.
